title: Rigveda
author: The oldest Veda
intro: The oldest of the four Vedas: 1,028 hymns in ten books (mandalas). Here are its most famous mantras: the Gayatri and the Mahamrityunjaya, the very first hymn (to Agni), the Nasadiya hymn on creation, and the Purusha Sukta.
note: Vedic mantras are traditionally chanted with pitch accents (svara); they are written here without accent marks, as in most popular editions. Numbers like 10.129.3 mean book 10, hymn 129, verse 3.
